items.title: Pharma companies team up to reduce heat-related emissions
items.summary: Pharmaceutical companies Sanofi, Opella and UCB have joined AstraZeneca as founders of the Clean Heat Program, which aims to reduce the use of fossil fuel-generated heat in industrial processes by helping companies transition to low-carbon alternatives.

items.title: THREE WEEKS TO GO: What SMEs need to know before investing in solar
items.summary: Taking place on 5 November, this upcoming webinar will explore how SMEs can overcome the financial and practical barriers to onsite solar and maximise the return on their investment.

items.title: COP17: Governments urged to accelerate action on 2030 nature goals
items.summary: As negotiators ready themselves for next week's biodiversity summit in Armenia, green groups like the European Environment Bureau (EEB) and WWF have raised concerns over the European Union's (EU) nature finance ambitions.

items.title: Government unveils performance certificates to assess property flood risk
items.summary: The UK Government and Flood Re have launched new Flood Performance Certificates (FPCs), which will help homeowners access flood risk and resilience information about their properties in a consistent, accessible format.

items.title: TWO WEEKS TO GO: How AI can accelerate investment in climate solutions
items.summary: With just two weeks to go, sustainability professionals are invited to register for an upcoming edie webinar exploring how artificial intelligence (AI), market intelligence and human expertise can help businesses identify credible climate investment opportunities and secure the financial backing needed to turn sustainability ambitions into action.

items.title: edie’s 30 Under 30: Applications close THIS FRIDAY
items.summary: There’s just a few days left to nominate for edie’s 30 Under 30 Class of 2027, an initiative that celebrates the rising stars driving meaningful change across business.

items.title: Climate risk and the UK food supply: What lies beyond the farm?
items.summary: The summer of 2026 brought the vulnerability of our food system to a changing climate into sharp focus.

items.title: 報告示警：AI快速發展 可能引發電子廢棄物海嘯
items.summary: 10月14日是國際電子廢棄物日，除了手邊常見的閒置電子產品，隨著AI快速發展，未來更可能帶來「電子廢棄物海嘯」。今（2026）年9月，國際環保組織巴塞爾行動網絡（Basel Action Network，BAN）發布報告示警，未來25年，AI製造的電子廢棄物若全部裝進貨櫃，數量足以繞地球六圈。

items.title: 不用的手機別再收抽屜 回收抽iPhone 17等好禮
items.summary: 你家有用不到的舊手機嗎？現在拿去回收，還能抽獎換好禮！環境部「 」開跑，即日起至10月31日止，民眾可將廢手機帶至活動回收據點，除有機會抽iPhone 17、Apple Watch等大獎，各手機品牌、電信及通路業者也依不同回收方式提供加碼優惠。

items.title: 全台首例竹林碳匯專案通過審查、美法官下令暫停川普翻新高爾夫球場砍樹、尼日大規模油氣井噴釀嚴重環境事故
items.summary: ## 全台首例竹林碳匯專案通過審查、美法官下令暫停川普翻新高爾夫球場砍樹、尼日大規模油氣井噴釀嚴重環境事故 農業部林業及自然保育署媒合中華電信投入桃園市復興區的竹林經營計畫，已通過環境部碳匯審查並公告，成為全台首件完成註冊的竹林經營碳匯自願減量專案。
